summary: After a Copilot work session the driver re-judges every call that ran, using the hook's own parser and judge handed in by the CLI, and halts with exit 9 and FENCE BYPASSED work after one stderr line per denied call.
verified: vloop task gate T1 equivalent (sh .vloop/state/gates/T1/gate.sh) exited 0 and printed gate T1: ok; go vet, gofmt, go test ./... pass (internal/cli TaskGate tests need VLOOP_PLAN_SHA256 unset, which the session sets).
notes: Seam: driver.CallJudge (fencecheck.go) is set on Iterator.Judge by cli/run.go (cli.CallJudge builds a payload and runs parseHookPayload, then decideCall, which the hook now shares incl. the empty-command rule). Runner.Judge is opt-in, so tools/agent-eval is unchanged. Runner.Run fills Result.Bypassed for Copilot sessions before Parse, so a session with no result event is judged too. Iterator.fenceBypassed is called in workSession after restoreInputs and before gitChanged/gitRefsMoved; T2 can call it from the other phases, and F2 (HOOK CHANGED) must go before it. Harness stub copilot now takes every phase prompt and STUB_CALLS; TestRunHarnessCopilot only changed its refused prompt to /vloop:bogus T1.
